name: Slide For Brainrots
desc:
👋 Welcome to Slide For Brainrots!

🗣️ YOUR BRAINROTS MAKE MONEY OFFLINE!!!!!!

How to Play:
🌊 Slide Down the Ramp and avoid Obstacles!
🤑 Grab Brainrots while sliding!
💸 Brainrots Generate Money!
🔥 Discover over 400 Brainrots!

👍 Like the game and join the group for more epic stuff!
